title: Permission policy is live at every METHOD checkpoint
summary: Unlike Access Control admission, method Permission is not a session grant. AlchemyPermissionPolicyAdapter resolves the currently operative Permission policy immediately before Security Effect and Permission evaluation for each protected METHOD checkpoint.
invariants: Permission policy is resolved anew for every protected METHOD checkpoint.
A Permission policy successor affects the next method call in the same still-valid Access Control session.
No method capability is minted or reused across calls.
Session Access Control liveness is checked before live Permission policy resolution.

provenance.claim: Access Control is pinned to admission while Permission policy is resolved at every METHOD checkpoint.
Each METHOD evaluation first validates session state, resolves current Permission policy, obtains Security Effect and emits a fresh exact Permission decision.
